how: Made by hand on 2026-11-17, after G-3's Linux run at this commit, from another project's watcher's status file and period and from the host's journal, read after the run, with each time in UTC. A login the watcher's status file records is placed by that line; one computed from the period between two recorded lines is given with its bounds as start and end. A gate entry's case names the seed and run it fell in, as the gate's own table gives them; a fuzz entry's case names the target.

not_listed.what: another project's watcher's remote logins, about every half hour from 2026-11-14T15:22:16Z, each reading the host's window state and a few files
not_listed.why: those that fell in the refused attempts of the kernel benchmark (four) and in the fuzz step that was no result (one) touch no committed file; the rest are listed as entries, each recorded time from the watcher's status file and each computed time with its bounds

not_listed.what: the host's own scheduled jobs: a repository backup every fifteen minutes, a health collector and two small watchers every five minutes, two sync jobs every ten minutes, a file backup about hourly and daily maintenance
not_listed.why: they run through every window and were not stopped, as nothing on the host is changed for a measurement beyond the governor; the run records keep no list of them by phase apart from the events listed here, and what guards each timed figure is the per-CPU record of the other processors' use and the load rule

entries.what: the host's scheduled repository backup, from the host's journal as read after the run, not from the run's own records
entries.case: the bound-seed gate, between runs of its seeds
